Class RMIServer

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.server.RMIServer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Loggable, Serializable, Remote
public class RMIServer extends UnicastRemoteObject implements Loggable
The RMI Server implementation handling remote procedure calls from clients. It manages player logins, game configuration, and leaderboard requests by interacting with the game Lobby and the database layer.
